༄༅/ /chos mngon pa nas 'byung ba'i don thor bu lha mi rnams la bde sdug bkres skom nor 'bru sogs yod med kyi khyad par go slar bshad pa ces bya ba

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos mngon pa nas 'byung ba'i don thor bu lha mi rnams la

bde sdug bkres skom nor 'bru sogs yod med kyi khyad par go slar bshad pa ces bya ba bzhugs/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes kun/ /gcig bsdus gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter chen zhes/ /yongs su grags pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /'dir 'jig rten bzhag pa sogs nas 'byung ba'i don 'ga' zhig bsdus nas brjod par bya ste/ de yang stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i 'og gi rlung dkyil ni thun mong ba gcig yin pa la/ sa chu'i dkyil 'khor ni gling bzhi po so so la re re yod cing*/ gling gzhi stong*/ nyi zla stong*/ 'dod lha rig drug stong*/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten rnams stong du longs pa la stong dang po/ /stong dang po de stong du longs pa la stong gnyis pa bar ma/ stong gnyis pa de stong du longs pa la stong gsum gyi stong chen po ste/ de rnams dang po 'chags pa dang mthar 'jig pa yang dus mnyam/ de 'dra ba'i stong gsum steng 'og phyogs bcu kun nas mtha' yas shing grangs med pa zhig yod la/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gcig na gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya/ nyi zla bye ba phrag brgya/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi sogs 'dod lha rigs drug bye ba phrag brgya/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten gsum bye ba phra brgya re yod cing*/bye ba phrag brgya la ni dung 'phyur bcu yod/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab ni gling bzhi'i dbus na yod kyang*/ gling so so'i byang ngos na yod de/ mtshon na/ 'dzam gling gi shar phyogs ni lus 'phags po'i lho/ sgra mi snyan gyi byang*/ ba lang spyod kyi shar yin na te/ gling gang du nyi ma dang por 'char sa de/ gling de'i shar phyogs/ nyi ma nub 'gro ba dai/ gling de'i nub phyogs su 'gyur ro/ /'dzam bu'i gling du nyi ma phyed kyi dus su ni/ shar na nyi ma nub/ byang du nam phyed/ nub tu nyi ma 'char ba de bzhin du gling gang na nyin phyed yin pa de'i rgyab kyi gling der nas phyed yin pa sogs 'gre'o/

/nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ni rgyu me shel/ zheng la dpag tshad nga gcig zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni rgyu chu shel/ zheng du dpag tshad lnga bcu/ gnyis ka'i mthar zheng gi sum 'gyur/ nang du lha'i bu nyi ma dang zla ba 'khor bcas/ skar ma che ba'i zheng la rgyang grags bco brgyad/ 'bring po rnams bcu skor/ chung ba la bzhi'am gcigade dag gi nang na lha gnas so/ /ri rab kyi rtse sum cu rtsa gsum gyi gnas na brgya byin 'khor bcas/ ri rab kyi bang rim bzhi la rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha/ bang rim thog ma dang gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse mo'i phyogs bzhir rgyal chen bzhi 'khor bcas so/ /ri rab ky-i mthar gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gling bzh-i'i mi dang*/ 'dod lha rigs drug dang*/ khams gong ma rnams na bde sdug bkres skom nor 'bru sogs yod med mi mtshungs te/ spyir khams gsum po thams cad sdug bsngal gsum gyi nang nas 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal gyis bcings pa las ma 'das kyang*/ gling bzhi'i mi dang 'dod lha rigs drug na tshor ba sdug bsngal yod/ gzugs dang gzugs med kyi khams na tshor ba sdug bsngal med cing*/ 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal 'gags pa yang med/ gling bzhi'i mi dang 'dod lha rigs drug na bkres skom yod/ khams gong ma gnyis na de med do/ /gling gsum na/ 'bras chan dang*/ zan dang*/ phye dang*/ sha dang*/ khur ba'i zas yod/ sgra mi snyan na de dag med kyang ma rmos ma btab pa'i 'bras sa lu za/ 'dod lha rigs drug na bdud rtsi'i zas yod/ khams gong ma gnyis na khams kyi zas med kyang reg pa sems pa rnam shes kyi zas tsam ni yod/ gling bzhi na bshang gci 'byung ba yod/ lha rnams la de med do/ /gling gsum na lo legs mi legs kyi mu ge yod/ sgra mi snyan dang lha rnams la de med do/ /gling gsum gyi mi dang 'dod lha rigs drug la 'jigs skrag yod/ sgra mi snyan pa dang*/ khams gong ma gnyis na de med do/

/gling gsum na gser dngul sogs kyi nyo tshong yod/ sgra mi snyan dang lha rnams la de med do/ /gling gsum dang 'dod lha rigs drug la kha dog sna tshogs yod/ sgra mi snyan dang gzugs khams pa thams cad kha dog dkar po/ /gzugs med na kha dog gi dbye ba med do/ /gling gsum na khang ba ched du byas ma byas gnyis yod/ sgra mi snyan na ched du ma byas pa'i sa khang yod/ 'dod lha rigs drug na khang pa ched du byas ma byas gnyis ka yod/ gzugs khams na ched du ma byas pa'i gzhal med khang yod/ gzugs med na khang pa med do/ /'dzam bu'i gling na gos kyi rigs sna tshogs/ lus 'phags dang ba lang spyod na be'u ras/ sgra mi snyan dang 'dod lha rigs drug na dpag bsam gyi shing las byung ba'i gos/ gzugs khams pa'i lha rnams gos gyon bzhin du skye/ gzugs med na gos med do/ /gling bzhi dang 'dod lha rigs drug na pho mo'i dbang po tha dad du dbyer yod/ gzugs khams na pho mo'i dbang po med kyang pho mo yod cing*/ de yang skad gzer mtho mi mtho dang nu ma'i khyad par gyis 'jogagazugs med na pho mo'i khyad par med do/ /gling gsum dang 'dod lha rigs drug na bag ma gtong len yod/ sgra mi snyan dang khams gong ma gnyis na de med do/ /gling gsum na shin tu tsha ba dang grang ba yod/ sgra mi snyan dang lha rnams la de med do/ /gling bzhi dang 'dod lha rigs drug na dbyar dgun sogs kyi tha snyad yod/ khams gong ma gnyis na de med do/ /gling bzhi dang 'dod lha rigs drug na nyin mtshan gyi tha snyad yod/ khams gong ma gnyis na de med do/ /gling bzhi dang 'dod lha rigs drug na rgyal pham brtsi ba yod/ khams gong ma gnyis na de med do/ /gling bzhi'i mi yi lus la rags pa'i sha khrag rus gsum yod/ lha'i lus la de med do/ /gling bzhi dang 'dod lha rigs drug na pha ma dang bu'i tha snyad yod/ khams gong ma gnyis na de med do/

/gling gsum dang 'dod lha rigs drug na rje bo dpon dang bran g.yog gi khyad par yod/ sgra mi snyan dang khams gong ma gnyis na de med do/ /gling gsum na nor dang 'bru yod/ sgra mi snyan na 'bru yod kyang nor med/ 'dod lha rigs drug na nor yod kyang 'bru med/ khams gong ma gnyis na nor 'bru gnyis ka med do/ /gling gsum na pha ma bu nor 'bru sogs la zhen pa yod/ sgra mi snyan na de dag gang la'ang zhen pa med/ 'dod lha rigs drug na 'bru ma gtogs pa gzhan la zhen pa yod/ khams gong ma gnyis na de dag la zhen pa med do/ /gling bzhi na bud med zla mtshan dang ldan pa dang sbrum ma las bu btsa' ba yod/ 'dod lha rigs drug na lha'am lha mo'i phrag pa'am pad mar brdzun te skye/ khams gong ma gnyis na de lta ma yin yang brdzun te skye'o/ /gling bzhi'i mi shi ba la ro yod/ lha shi na ro med do/ gling bzhi dang rgyal chen bzhi sum cu rtsa gsum rnams na gnyis gnyis dbang po sprad nas 'khrig pa bsten/ 'thab bral ba 'khyud pa tsam dang*/ dga' ldan pa lag pa bcangs pa tsam dang*/ 'phrul dga' ba bgad pa tsam dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa bltas pa tsam gyis gdung ba zhi bar 'gyur te/ de'i tshe gling bzhi na khu khrag 'byung*/ 'dod lha rigs drug na rlung tsam 'byung*/ khams gong na de lta bu'i 'dod chags med do/ /mi dang 'dod lha la zhe sdang skye ba dang srog gcod pa yod/ khams gong ma gnyis na med do/ /bskal pa dang bo'i mi rnams ni brdzus te skyes shing pho mo'i dbye ba med kyang*/ phyis dbang po tha dad du gyur nas mngal skyes su gyur/ lha dang dmyal ba pa dang rab do ba rnams ni brdzus skyes kho na/ yi dwags phal cher brdzus skyes yin te/ mngal skyes byang yod/ dud 'gro la skye gnas bzhi ka yod/ tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus su bu mo lo lnga brgya lon pa'i tshe bag mar gtong*/ 'bru rnams che shing*/

snye ma re re yang bre bo che bzhi re 'ong*/ tshe lo bcu pa'i dus su bu mo zla ba lnga lon pa'i tshe bag mar gtong*/ 'bru rnams shin tu chung zhing nyung ba dang med par 'gyur ro/ /mthar mtshon dang nad dang mu ge gsum gyis stong la khad byas nas/ slar tshe rim gyis yar 'phel te mi rnams ni tshe lo brgyad khri re thub pa 'byung ngo*/ /rags rtsis su da lta'i 'dzam bu'i gling pa rnams tshe lo brgya pa zer yang drug cu kha ral/ lus 'phags po rnams tshe lo phyed dang sum brgya/ ba lang spyod pa rnams tshe lo lnga brgya yin te dus min du 'chi ba yod/ byang sgra mi snyan pa rnams ni tshe lo stong thub par nges so/ /dud 'gro las klu'i rgyal po la ni tshe bskal bar thub pa yod cing*/ dud 'gro tshe thung ba 'ga' ni nyin zhag re gnyis tsam las mi gnas pa yang srid/ yi dwags tshe ring ba ni mi lo khri lnga stong thub/ rgyal chen bzhi ba'i lha'i tshe tshad ni mi lo sa ya dgu/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa ni mi lo sa ya drug /'thab bral ba ni mi lo bye ba bcu bzhi dang sa ya bzhi/ dga' ldan pa ni mi lo bye ba dang bdun dang sa ya drug 'phrul dga' ba ni mi lo bye ba nyis brgya sum cu dang sa ya bzhi/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa ni mi lo bye ba dgu brgya nyer gcig dang sa ya drug go /tshangs ris pa'i tshe tshad bar bskal phyed/ tshangs pa 'dun 'don ni bar bskal gcig tshangs chen pa ni bar bskal phyed gnyis/ 'od chung ba bskal ba gnyis/ tshad med 'od bskal ba bzhi/ 'od gsal ba bskal ba brgyad/ de bzhin du gong ma rnams nyis 'gyur dus byas nas/ 'og min pa ni bskal ba chen po khri drug stong ngo*/ /gzugs med dang po'i tshe tshad ni bskal ba nyis khri/ gnyis pa bskal ba bzhi khri/ gsum pa bskal ba drug khri/ bzhi pa bskal ba chen po brgyad khri'o/ /yang tsha dmyal dang po yang sos pa'i tshe tshad ni mi lo bye ba phrag 'bum drug khri nyis stong thub ste/

thig nag sogs lhag ma rnams brgyad 'gyur gyis ring la/ mnar med kyi tshe tshad bar bskal gcig go /brgyad po re re'i 'khor na dmyal ba gzhan bcu drug re yod cing*/ mdo myang 'das dang thar chen las ni dmyal ba mi 'dra ba mang po zhig kyang bshad do/ /grangs dmyal dang po chu bur can gyi tshe ni/ yul dbus ma ga dha'i bre bo che khal brgyad cu shong ba'i bang ba nas lo brgya nas til re re phyung bas nam zad par 'gyur ba'i yun tshad dang mnyam zhing*/ lhag ma chu bur rdol ba can sogs bdun gyi tshe ni/ snga ma las phyi ma'i shu nyi shus 'bar zhing ring ngo*/ /sgra mi snyan pa ma gtogs sngar smros pa de dag bar ma dor 'chi ba ni yod do/ /bskal ba dang po'i mi'i tshe tshad ni/ tshangs ris pa'i lha'i tshe dang mnyam pa'am dpag tu med cing lus kyang shin tu che'o/ /da lta'i mi lus phal cher ni khru bzhi pa/ shar na khru brgyad/ nub na khru bcu drug /byang du khru so gnyis/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi rgyang grags kyi bzhi cha/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa de'i cha gnyis/ 'thab bral ba cha gsum dga' ldan pa rgyang grags gcig /'phrul dga' pa rgyang grags gcig dang bzhi cha/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa rgyang grags phyed dang gnyis so/ /tshangs ris pa'i lus dpag tshad phyed/ tshangs pa bdun 'don pa dpag tshad gcigatshangs chen pa phyed gnyis/ 'od chung ba gnyis/ de nas gnyis 'gyur byas te tshad med 'od bzhi/ 'od gsal ba brgyad nas/ 'og min pa'i lus dpag tshad khri drug stong ste/ 'on kyang spṛn med pa ni dpag tshad gsum 'dod/ lha min gyi dbang po sgra gcan gyi lus ni ri rab bzhin dang*/ gzhan phal cher rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa'i lus lta bu dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lus kyi tshad du longs pa'ang yod/ klu chen brgyad kyi lus ni shin tu che la/ gzhan che chung ci rigs so/ /de rnams su skye ba'i rgyu ni las dge sdig gnyis su nges te gzhan med la/

de yang dge ba'i las ci rigs kyis lha dang mir skye zhing bde ba myong la/ mi dge ba'i las kyis ni ngan 'gro de rnams su skye zhing sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur te/ rin chen 'phreng ba las/ mi dge ba las sdug bsngal kun/ /de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do/ /dge las bde 'gro thams cad dang*/ /skye ba kun tu bde ba dag /ces gsungs pa ltar ro/ /dge mi dge'i las rnam grangs mang yang rigs bsdu na las lam bcur 'du ba yin te/ mdzod las/ de las che long bsdus nas ni/ /dge dang mi dge ci rigs par/ /las kyi lam ni bcur gsungs so/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bde sdug gnyis su ma zad/ snod bcud thams cad rang rgyu sems dang 'brel ba'i las las byung ba yin te/ mdzod las/ 'jig rten sna tshogs las las skyes/ /zhes dang*/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ sems nyid kyis ni sems can 'jig rten dang*/ /snod kyi 'jig rten shin tu sna tshogs 'god/ /'gro ba ma lus las las skyes par gsungs/ /zhes 'byung ba ltar ro/ /las kyis thob pa'i bde sdug gi rigs mang yang bde ba thams cad kyi nang nas zhi ba'i bde ba ches mchog dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad kyi nang nas mnar med kyi sdug bsngal ches bzod dka' ba yin te/ bshes sprin las/ bde ba kun gyi nang nas sred zad pa/ bde ba'i bdag po bgyid pa ji lta bar/ /de bzhin sdug bsngal kun gyi nang nas ni/ /mnar med dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rab mi zad/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /dgra bcom pa 'ga' zhig la sngon byas pa'i las rnam smin ma phyung ba du ma zhig yod srid kyang sred sogs kyi nyon mongs zad pas las de dag gis rnam smin 'byin mi nus te/ rnam 'grel las/ sred pa'i sred las rnam brgal ba/ /las gzhan 'phen nus ma yin te/ /lhan cig byed pa zad phyir ro/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bya med lag dal byung ba las/ /blo ldan 'ga' la phan snyam ste/ /tshul 'di bkod pa'i rnam dkar

dges/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas nyid gyur cig /ces mngon pa'i don thor bu 'di yang*/ shākya'i dge slong bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne'i dgon nyid du dad pas sbyar pa'o/ /maṅga laṃ/ / // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/chos mngon las 'byung ba'i don thor bu lha mi rnams la bde sdug bkres skom nor 'bru sogs yod med bzhugs/ -PAGE 454--PAGE 447--PAGE 446-
